<!-- pr-reviewer: 7d641c8b7b7ed84da5a6cfd2fb98ee7b305a24a3 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (merges at the cut, since it carries a `feat`).

**What looks good**
- The removed two-edge plane mode leaves nothing half-reachable. `pick::lay_on_plane` (`crates/app/src/pick/plane.rs`, `datum_of`) refuses an edge by name. The `AlignPartToSetup::lay_on_plane` command, the UI draft (`state.rs:3068`) and the MCP route all go through that one function. The saved alignment is still a plain `Location`, so nothing in the project file records a mode: there is no format change and project load is unaffected (`project_roundtrip` passes). No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` was found in the new non-test code.
- Operation-geometry edge picking is untouched. In `interact.rs` the new `axis_pick::collecting` branch only fires while an axis draft is picking, and the boundary and operation paths are unchanged. The `boundary_picks` and `edge_loop_pick` ui tests named in the PR body were not re-run here.
- The new axis turn goes through the existing undoable `AlignPartToSetup` command, validates before any write, and refuses degenerate picks by name. It is pinned by tests for undo and redo, composition after a face lay, and stale picks.
- Decision records are present for both issues, the body ends with `Fixes #557` / `Fixes #554`, and it has `Changelog:` lines. No `CHANGELOG.md`, snapshot PNG, `build.rs`, `.github`, script or dependency changes.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, which was already up to date)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app` test build | ok |
| axis_align | 10 passed |
| plane_align | 8 passed |

The one ui failure is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` ("No suitable graphics adapter found"). It is the machine, not the PR.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` (1859 lines) and `tests.rs` (5056 lines) were already over the 400-line guide. The PR adds only one line to `pages.rs` and the `tests.rs` change is a small mod hook. The new modules are small.
- #554 is a fix riding with a feat, as the PR body says. `7d641c8b` can be split out if the fix is wanted before the cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 135977437107068d5aaa54a1d35cadb2d3d3285e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (re-review of the three hand-check fixes; the PR is a `feat`, so it merges at the cut).

**What looks good**
- The stray-click hook is narrow. `hint_stray` (crates/ui/src/axis_pick.rs:152) only swallows when `axis_rows_shown` is true, no axis is collecting and no `plane_pick` is open. `axis_rows_shown` is reset every frame in `pages.rs:109` and set only by the Setups page axes rows (`setup_axis_pick.rs:23`). So default Model pick with no setup page open, and an operation's geometry pick with an operation page open (the flag is false there), are unaffected. The call sits after `axis_pick::take` and `plane_pick::take`, so the lay-on-a-plane face pick keeps working and the 3-point pick is untouched. `boundary_pick` is checked after it, and it needs an operation page, so it never coexists with the axes rows. The early-returns in interact.rs `pick_face`, `pick_edge` and vertex_pick.rs are not too broad.
- Choosing "by Edge" / "by Two points" arms the pick (`set_by`). Re-choosing the current mode keeps the picks. A changed mode clears them.
- The picked-points row goes through `picks_text` with `units::len` / `unit.suffix()`, so it reads in document units. There is no raw entity or vertex id.
- Apply keeps the picks. Re-Apply of the same picks is greyed out ("applied - tick Flip ..."). Flip after Apply enables a 180 degree Apply. `TurnPartInPlane` goes through `AlignPartToSetup::turn_in_plane` and `history.execute`, so each Apply is one undo step and `invert` restores the previous alignment. This meets the Everything-Is-a-Command law.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` on the new paths; the sqrt/length math guards `l > 0 && finite`.
- No snapshot PNGs, build.rs, `.github`, scripts or Cargo changes. Structural test updates are in `tests/structural.rs`. Provenance lines are present. New files are under 400 lines (the largest is `setup_axis_tests.rs` at 282).

**Local results** (merged with upstream/main: already up to date, no conflicts; `mergeable` reads MERGEABLE)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | ok |
| axis_align | 10 passed |
| plane_align | 8 passed |
| plane_align_edges | 5 passed |
| setup_align | 9 passed |
| winding_align | 9 passed |
| mcp_setup | 4 passed |
| commands_undo | 32 passed |
| camcraft-ui --lib | 386 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored. The failure is `headless_run_succeeds`, "No suitable graphics adapter found" (environmental, no GPU on this machine). The new `setup_axis_tests` and `tests/plane_face_pick.rs` tests pass. |
| clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

`points_align` and `turn_pivot` are not test targets in camcraft-app, so they were not run.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. Nothing disarms an armed axis draft when the user navigates off the Setups page. `pages.rs` only clears `boundary_pick` for non-operation targets. While `axis_pick.picking` is set, an Edge or Vertex click on an operation page would land in the axis draft rather than the operation geometry pick. The lay-on-a-plane draft (`plane_pick`) has the same behaviour, so it is consistent. If you want it tidy, a follow-up could disarm both when the pane target leaves a setup page.
2. `interact.rs` (1767 lines) and `state.rs` (3965 lines) were already over the ~400-line guideline; this PR grows them by about 27 and 41 lines. Noted, not blocking.
3. The PR body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #557` / `Fixes #554`, and the decisions are in `docs/decisions/`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
